quoted_tweet.text:
Someone should create "AI Summer Camp".

There are 254 million college students worldwide who know that AI is coming for them.

By the time today's college freshmen graduate, AI agents will have eliminated 80% of entry-level jobs. 

Enter “AI summer camp”

10 weeks. 50,000 students. Free upfront.

The curriculum could be something like

Week 1: Finding your niche (google trends, subreddits, @ideabrowser)

Week 1: building an audience/community with video (basically become the mr beast of your niche)

Week 2: finding your startup idea (claude, chatgpt, @ideabrowser)

Week 3-4: Vibe code your MVP (bolt, lovable, cursor)

Week 5-6: Iteration on MVP (customer feedback, hiring on upwork etc)

Week 7-8: Vibe marketing and automation (n8n, cursor, gumloop)

Week 9-10: Turn users into paying customers (pricing strategies etc)

No homework, just teaching kids to build.

And they spend most of the time building, not learning.

You learn through building. 

Mega different mindset than how school works today.

It could be free to attend. 10% revenue share for 2 years.

The unit economics are actually interesting

Say 50,000 students in Year 1:

- 60% make $0-1K (still better than unpaid internships)
- 25% make $1K-10K (enough to pay for school)
- 10% make $10K-50K (life-changing money)
- 5% make $50K+ (2,500 kids generating $125M+)

Your 10% cut = $12.5M in Year 1.

Could even bring that % cut down if you get sponsors etc

Those 2,500 success stories become your marketing department. They make viral TikToks. Building in public. They inspire their friends.

Year 2: 200,000 applications for 100,000 spots.
Year 3: You're processing $500M+ in student revenue annually.

And coolest part is you’re rewiring the brains of these students.

They are seeing what happens when you make your first $ on the internet

And they dont need to be dependent people giving them jobs when they graduate

Someone's going to build this and capture $100B+ in value as higher education loses popularity.

tweets.text:
how to generate great designs that CONVERT when vibe coding

I've always struggled with this aspect, trying to get on-brand or just really nice UI/designs when vibing...

I think I've solved it!

before you start, have Claude Code in your terminal

1) generate a PRD
2) give it to claude code, clearly communicate your goals
3) grab tailwind assets from Figma designs using the Anima plugin
4) give Claude Code a bunch of great designs to reference..I bought TailwindPlus and loaded it all into my IDE!
5) have your agent crawl through and understand what good looks like
6) start building a prototype

- in this project I also setup Github for version control and Vercel for deployment
- I migrated the site to Vercel and setup Vercel Analytics with custom events
- integrated a secure email collection form
- added calls to action to my community
- embedded an Airtable form on the get featured page

all in all, I have a full environment to work on this website and SHIP vs using a landing page builder before which was super limited.

I picked up a ton of knowledge doing this and am excited to see how it performs.

Quick walk through / tutorial below...
